bio: Now among the most famous restaurants on the Peninsula, Da Vittorio retains unchanged the warmth of its pleasantly family-run management. If, in fact, the kitchen and dining room are “frequented” by members of the Cerea family, even the dishes tell of their ability to process the best ingredients into well-presented recipes laden with flavour, in the successful pursuit of comfortable taste. And then there is generosity, which you will already find in the offer!
